intro.text: A lighteyed woman whom Adolin Kholin is courting.

items.text: Adolin began courting Malasha soon after Janala Lustow tired of him; she was religious, and he liked her enough to sit through readings from The Arguments. She cooled toward him after he refused to take her along on a plateau run, while he grew interested in Danlan Morakotha, and the two parted soon after.

appearance.text: She wears her hair up in braids and is considered very good-looking.

personality.text: Unusually for a religious Vorin woman, she is curious about war and asks Adolin to bring her to the battlefield, and she is annoyed when he refuses. Dalinar finds a woman's wish to watch fighting unnatural.
